_comment: Fragment 108 — curated node for D-171 (explicit S2 hold on both T5/T6 orders; F6 Line/executor matrix, canary, blind review, return metric, and override rule drafted), correcting D-170's narrower stance per Lane B's B068-R8 completion review. Merged 2026-08-31.

nodes.label: D-171: Explicit S2 Hold; F6 Line/Executor Matrix Drafted
nodes.description: Chief Editor decision correcting D-170's narrower stance, answering Lane B's independent completion review of B-068 (B068-R8). D-170 left V1-BUILD-SPEC.md's current T5/T6 order build-authorized (D-164/D-165) even though a different order was decided as target -- silence was not authorization, but nothing said so, and Lane B could have built the already-superseded order in good faith. D-171 places an explicit hold on BOTH the current and target order: no T5/T6-sensitive route, RPC, UI, migration, or test starts until F6 lands and a fresh build authorization selects one contract. Also drafts F6 content: a Line/executor matrix for EG1-EG5 plus Delivery, derived from raci-involvement-matrix.md Section 4's existing rule that Line 2/Accountable sits only with the Acting Chief Editor (so Chief Editorial Desk at target T5 must be Line 1, not Line 2); relocates the human-only canary from T5 to T6; defines the blind-review sequence as an ordered event pair (disposition sealed, then reveal-and-decide); redefines the T6-to-T5 return metric for the inverted actor direction; and defines which role/Line substitutions count as an override. Gate evidence/negative tests and delivery-node protection remain undrafted, pending F4's CSV crosswalk. F3 and F4 remain fully open.
nodes.rationale: A decision that names a target without withdrawing authorization for the order it replaces leaves a gap exactly the size of 'silence' -- the next agent to read the build spec has no textual signal that the current order is no longer safe to build, and will reasonably read the absence of a hold as permission.
